polygon_coverage_image — DRIVE pegsym op

• Data kinds: matrix → image2d

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.polygon_coverage_image(vertices_px, size: 'int' = 160, ss: 'int' = 8, width: 'int | None' = None) -> 'np.ndarray' (implementation को सीधे call करना हो तो import pegsym; pegsym.polygon_coverage_image(vertices_px, size: 'int' = 160, ss: 'int' = 8, width: 'int | None' = None) -> 'np.ndarray', registry से लेना हो तो opsdrive.get("polygon_coverage_image"))

उपयोग

convex polygon (pixel coordinate (col, row) में vertex सूची) की coverage image 0..1 ((size, width); anti-aliasing ss × ss sub-sample से)। ground truth वाले synthesis का एक हिस्सा। Raises ValueError: convex नहीं है, size < 8, ss < 1।
